tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window background under the art. The base every panel and overlay sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Faint fill: hovered rows and menu items, chips, the facts panel, the segmented switch track.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Solid raised fill: toasts, the download strip, text inputs inside dialogs.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Solid 1px edges: chips, secondary buttons, the tab underline, the strip's top edge.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The panel level: top bar, rails, view headers and toolbars. Fixed 92% floor so text keeps AA over any art.

tokens.name: panel-solid
tokens.usage: Panels that scroll with their content (no backdrop blur). Same floor as panel.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: The overlay level: Details, dialogs, menus, hover labels. Opaque, always with shadow-overlay or shadow-lift.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims (and, with a 6px blur, softens) the shell behind a dialog.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline edge of panels, overlays and card labels.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of form controls (search, selects) and outline chips.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill of inputs and selects, the top-bar pill track, hovered rail rows.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The one selected-row tint, always paired with a 3px inset bar in primary.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The one keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Fill of the always-visible title label under a game cover.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on panel, overlay, surface and bg.

tokens.name: text-h
tokens.usage: Headings, active labels and values on panel and overlay.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: counts, meta lines, inactive pills and tabs, placeholders. AA on panel and overlay in both themes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand violet. Filled actions (Play, Install), the active view pill, the active tab underline, the selected-row bar, the brandmark.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed primary fill.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on a primary fill: white in light (8.3:1), the dark background in dark (white would be 3.65:1).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill (confirm uninstall).

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning colour used as text on panels.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Soft violet accent, used sparingly. Not for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: accent-warm
tokens.usage: Warm accent from RomM's palette. Decorative only.

tokens.name: favourite
tokens.usage: Favourite marker. Decorative only; never the only cue.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Installed dot and online status dot. A mark, never text; the word or tooltip carries the meaning.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: UPDATE tag fill (with #1a1a12 text), update-confirm fill, unlinked status dot.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors as text, destructive outlines, confirm fills, offline dot.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Cloud badge icon on the dark cover badge.

tokens.name: graph-disk
tokens.usage: Disk line in the download sparkline (network is primary).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Hardcore achievement gold, used as text: dark amber in light (5.4:1 on bg), bright in dark.

styles.name: view-title
styles.usage: Platform name in a view header; the Details title (h2).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The GRID wordmark beside the brandmark.

styles.name: description
styles.usage: Game descriptions, capped at 68ch, 0.75em between paragraphs.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: rail rows, buttons, tabs, pills, toasts.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Selected rail row, toast text, section headings in tabs.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Counts, meta lines, the download strip, select values, card title labels.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Header chips and status chips in Details.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Rail counts, control captions, fact labels (uppercase, 0.05em).

styles.name: rail-heading
styles.usage: Section headings in a rail (PLATFORMS), uppercase.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between shell panels and around them; the art shows through it.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: One height for every toolbar control (search, selects).

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: footer-h
tokens.usage: Download strip height.

tokens.name: r-control
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, dialog buttons.

tokens.name: r-chip
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, cover tags, the session chip.

tokens.name: r-row
tokens.usage: Rail rows, menus, toasts, card labels, the facts panel.

tokens.name: r-card
tokens.usage: Game covers.

tokens.name: r-dialog
tokens.usage: Details and other modal panels.

tokens.name: r-panel
tokens.usage: Shell panels: rails, view headers.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: View pills, header chips, the segmented switch, card Play/Install.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A cover at rest: a hairline only (blurred shadows on every cover cost too much at 4K).

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A hovered or focused cover, hover labels, the Details cover.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Overlays: Details, dialogs, the server menu.
